query_text: Where can I download the latest version of Python?

message.content:
You can download the latest version of Python from the official Python website. Here are the key details:

## Official Download Sources

**Primary Download Page:**
- Visit **https://www.python.org/downloads/** — This is the main download page where you can find the latest stable version of Python for your operating system (Windows, macOS, or Linux).

**Current Latest Version:**
- According to the official Python.org homepage, **Python 3.14.5** was released on May 10, 2026, and is the latest stable version available.

## How to Download

1. Go to **https://www.python.org/downloads/**
2. The page will automatically suggest the best version for your operating system
3. Click the download button to get the installer
4. For Windows users, you can also visit **https://www.python.org/getit/windows/** for Windows-specific downloads

## Alternative: Microsoft Store

Python is also available on the Microsoft Store for Windows users at:
- **https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9pnrbtzxmb4z**

## Important Tips for Installation

- **Windows users**: Make sure to check the box **"Add Python to PATH"** during installation so you can use Python from the command line
- You can choose between the standard installer or a custom installation if you want to change the default installation location
- For most users, the standard installer is recommended

Sources:
1. https://www.python.org/
2. https://www.python.org/downloads/
3. https://www.python.org/getit/windows/
4. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/download-and-install-python-3-latest-version/
5. https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9pnrbtzxmb4z?hl=zh-cn&gl=SK
6. https://community.chocolatey.org/packages/python313
7. https://docs.python.org/3.13/download.html
